audit.why: breakdown.early/mid/wave and content.early/mid correctly describe Blitzcrank owning levels 1-2 (Rocket Grab into Power Fist kill threat) and Rell taking over at 3 once mounted knockup punishes a whiffed hook.
Spikes at Lvl2 (Blitz's window), Lvl6 (Magnet Storm punishes a whiffed Q), 1st item, and Late are named with real abilities and match the packet level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.whys[1] names 'Power Fist-E chain' — Power Fist IS the E ability, so the sentence double-labels the same ability as two things. lintFindings/suspectNames flags this exact string (distance 1 from 'power fist'). Also phases[0].side and phases[1].side both read the enum placeholder 'Skill' while content win[0] and win[1] correctly say 'Blitzcrank', and phases[2..6].side likewise read 'Skill' against win[2..6]='Rell'.
audit.why: Fix the ability-name collision by naming the chain as Rocket Grab into Power Fist (not 'Q-Power Fist-E'). For the chart, win[N] already holds the correct verdict for every row, so per the decided chart rule I move side alone to match it; phases[0].why and phases[1].why are the two rows flipping to the enemy, so I rewrote both to state the real reason Blitzcrank wins those levels: Rocket Grab range (1079) plus the Power Fist (E) follow-up threatens a kill before Rell has knockup range or a completed Crash Down.
audit.corrected: whys[1] renamed to 'Rocket Grab into Power Fist'; phases[0-1].side=Blitzcrank (why rewritten); phases[2-6].side=Rell

edits.before: Blitzcrank wins level 2 because his Q-Power Fist-E chain out-bursts your uncompleted engage.
edits.after: Blitzcrank wins level 2 because his Rocket Grab into Power Fist chain out-bursts your engage.

edits.before: Mounted speed governs the lane's first minutes — the charge threat zones before it lands.
edits.after: Rocket Grab range plus a Power Fist follow-up threatens a kill before your knockup comes online.

edits.before: W crash online — the dismount knockup starts chains the lane can't refuse.
edits.after: His Q-into-Power Fist chain still outbursts Crash Down before it closes the gap.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Rocket Grab is down 20s at rank 1 (16s by rank 5) — trade or engage inside that window before he can re-load the hook.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: His Q is live at 1079 range — trading now hands him a Rocket Grab into Power Fist chain that can kill you.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. It writes your spacing rules. - E Full Tilt (remount speed) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - His Q Rocket Grab (20/19/18/17/16s) is the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim while it's up. - E Power Fist (7-5s) resets off autos, so the wind-up is your cue to back off. - Your R (120/100/80s) opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
